inputs.pkg3_evidence: package-3 development run (switch branch at product_sha base): 6,166 regressions, 3,368 isolation-only failures

method: Population: every tracked path under tests/ at product_sha (2,226 Python files and 454 data files).

Owners come from this rename map (pre-tests entries) through lu_machinery.lint.mypy_ratchet._RenameMap, the map's consumer; tracked product paths outside the map, packages/*/src distributions and root config or entry points (pyproject.toml, package.json, start-*.sh, Makefile, ...) are product; LU modules absent from the freeze map count as product.

Subject of a Python file: modules it imports (qualified, relative, and unqualified through pytest pythonpath=scripts), dotted module names in non-docstring strings (patch targets, -m), tracked repository paths in strings, and path expressions anchored at the real checkout root. Fixture layouts under tmp_path, bare root directories, runtime-state trees and mixed-owner directories name no subject.

A file with any product subject is product (mixed stays product until its product assertions are preserved elsewhere); a file with only machinery subjects is machinery. A file with no subject inherits from the tests modules it imports (excluding conftest and package markers), else was read by hand (evidence says so), else is product.

Support modules: product when any product test uses them or they name a product subject; conftest/__init__ by the files they serve. Data files: by the test files that name them or their directory; machinery only when every user is machinery.

delete-at-switch requires every pytest-collected test name of the file (Class::function, all parameters) to exist under the same name in machinery v0.1.0 and on machinery main, with a normalized body similarity of at least 0.5, and to pass on the installed v0.1.0 wheel (replacement_runs). Otherwise port-first, listing each missing or failing name.
